abstract: BACKGROUND: Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is a rare complication. While any of the constituent tissues of a teratoma has the potential to undergo malignant transformation, squamous cell carcinoma is the most commonly associated malignancy. Renal carcinoid tumors are rare and frequently associated with horseshoe kidney and renal teratoma. Renal teratoma rarely presents together with carcinoid tumor or adenocarcinoma. To the best of our knowledge, there has never been a report of renal teratoma coexisting with both carcinoid tumor and adenocarcinoma. METHODS: Here, we present a unique and first case of synchronous primary carcinoid tumor and moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma arising within mature cystic teratoma of horseshoe kidney in a 50-year-old female. Lumbar spine X-ray, done for her complaint of progressive chronic low back pain, accidentally found a large calcification overlying the lower pole of the right kidney. Further radiologic studies revealed horseshoe kidney and a large multi-septated cystic lesion immediately anterior to the right renal pelvis with central calcification and peripheral enhancement. She underwent right partial nephrectomy. RESULTS: Macroscopically, the encapsulated complex solid and multiloculated cystic tumor with large calcification, focal thickened walls and filled with yellow-tan gelatinous material. Microscopically, the tumor showed coexistent mature cystic teratoma, moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma and carcinoid tumor. Immunohistochemically, alpha-methylacyl-coenzyme A-racemase, calretinin, CD10 and thyroid transcription factor-1 were negative in all the three components of the tumor. The teratomatous cysts lined by ciliated epithelium showed strong staining for cytokeratin 7 and pancytokeratin, and those lined by colonic-like epithelium showed strong staining for CDX2, cytokeratin 20 and pancytokeratin, but both were negative for calretinin. Additionally, the teratomatous cyst wall showed strong staining for smooth muscle actin, and weak staining for carbonic anhydrase IX, CD99, chromogranin and synaptophysin. The adenocarcinoma component was strongly positive for cytokeratin 7 and pancytokeratin, weakly positive for synaptophysin and CD56, and negative for carbonic anhydrase IX, CD99, CDX2, chromogranin, cytokeratin 20 and smooth muscle actin. The carcinoid tumor component was strongly positive for CD56, chromogranin and synaptophysin, weakly positive for pancytokeratin, and negative for carbonic anhydrase IX, CD99, CDX2, cytokeratin 7, cytokeratin 20 and smooth muscle actin. She received no adjuvant therapy and is alive without evidence of disease six months after diagnosis and surgery. CONCLUSION: This unique and first case herein presented with synchronous primary carcinoid tumor and primary adenocarcinoma arising within mature cystic teratoma of horseshoe kidney emphasizes the need for thorough sectioning and entire submission for histologic evaluation of mature cystic teratomas, in order to avoid missing multiple additional histogenetically distinct neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 背景: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化はまれな合併症である。奇形腫のどの構成組織も悪性転化しうるが、最も多く関連する悪性腫瘍は扁平上皮癌である。腎カルチノイド腫瘍はまれで、馬蹄腎や腎奇形腫に伴うことが多い。腎奇形腫がカルチノイド腫瘍と腺癌を同時に伴うことは、これまで報告されていない。方法: 50歳女性の症例を提示する。進行性の慢性腰痛の精査で行った腰椎X線検査で、右腎下極を覆う大きな石灰化が偶然見つかった。さらなる画像検査で馬蹄腎と、右腎盂前方に中心性の石灰化と周辺増強を伴う大きな多房性嚢胞性病変が認められた。右腎部分切除術を受けた。結果: 肉眼的には、大きな石灰化と局所的に肥厚した壁を有し、黄色から茶褐色のゼラチン様物質で満たされた被包性の複雑な充実性・多房性嚢胞性腫瘍であった。組織学的には、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、中分化型腺癌、カルチノイド腫瘍が共存していた。免疫組織化学的には、3成分すべてでalpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase、calretinin、CD10、TTF-1が陰性であった。奇形腫の嚢胞は繊毛上皮で覆われ、サイトケラチン7とpancytokeratinに強陽性、結腸様上皮で覆われた嚢胞はCDX2、サイトケラチン20、pancytokeratinに強陽性であったが、いずれもcalretininは陰性であった。奇形腫嚢胞壁は平滑筋アクチンに強陽性、カルボニックアンヒドラーゼIX、CD99、クロモグラニン、シナプトフィジンに弱陽性であった。腺癌成分はサイトケラチン7とpancytokeratinに強陽性、シナプトフィジンとCD56に弱陽性で、カルボニックアンヒドラーゼIX、CD99、CDX2、クロモグラニン、サイトケラチン20、平滑筋アクチンは陰性であった。カルチノイド成分はCD56、クロモグラニン、シナプトフィジンに強陽性、pancytokeratinに弱陽性で、カルボニックアンヒドラーゼIX、CD99、CDX2、サイトケラチン7、サイトケラチン20、平滑筋アクチンは陰性であった。補助療法は受けず、診断と手術から6か月後も無病生存している。結論: 本症例は、馬蹄腎の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた同時性の原発性カルチノイド腫瘍と原発性腺癌という独特かつ初めての症例であり、見落としを防ぐため成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は十分な切片作製と全体の組織学的評価が必要であることを強調する。
